name: severity-calibration
description: Calibration eval for judge-severity. Runs severity-classify against the labeled severity-calibration dataset and scores the emitted severity EXACTLY against the human label. Pass rate = routing accuracy; the per-row drilldown shows exactly which incidents the judge mis-ranks (and in which direction — inflating vs. deflating), which is what you tune the rubric against. Run it from the Evals page, or replay the dataset through /api/runs/start. This is the template for calibrating any judge: an exact scorer over a labeled branch.
